changes: Default-off bounded FIFO presentation experiment with independent GPU texture snapshots and a half-refresh clock. Preserves source duplicate detection; logs shortages, overflow and state-load discards.
Process-local additive Wii/Nunchuk acceleration, native Nunchuk shake waveform, atomic controller state updates, and optional release=0 for pad_frames chords.
Per-command failure reasons published before failed receipts and retained in benchmark results.
Tests cover clock overflow/cadence/underflow, input parsing, and actual serialized Nunchuk motion/button reports without host input.
PS2-derived Xbox target controls appended to the performance plan; full Xbox translation remains pending.

visual_validation: Four held-shake captures inspected sequentially: X-axis native shake opened the fusion tutorial; remaining captures stayed in that modal. Not combat FPS evidence.
Four intermediate selection captures inspected sequentially: the game required a pointer readiness confirmation; first attempted portrait aim was outside the screen. Not a successful selection.

Five corrected selection captures inspected sequentially: readiness icon targeted and accepted, Captain America portrait targeted, stars consumed and web/attack effects visible after selection. Tutorial banner remained; no claim of full tutorial completion.

Earlier native constant-binding shake probe did not activate fusion; background input gating makes it insufficient to assess the native waveform. New process-local shake test bypasses that dependency.
audio_scope: Cubeb backend confirmed. Audible quality/synchronization not verified.
controller_scope: Process-local gesture and portrait-selection proof only. No physical Xbox button validation, completed XInput layout, direct hero selection, or camera validation yet.
private_data: Original game data, generated translations, saves, captures, raw traces, reference manuals and logs remain ignored under .local. Existing user static diagnostics and Build-With-Log.cmd are excluded from this commit.
next: Implement and validate the PS2-style Xbox adapter using the proven native shake and pointer path.
Profile guest frame production in the crowded fight; retain normal speed, original effects and 3x EFB.
Finish three repeats and ten-minute varied combat acceptance only after candidate improvements.
